- [arrow-left.svg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/53fab88ff9d1b48f4704b5b5b560d6b4d560bf4c/icons/arrow-left.svg)
- [arrow-right.svg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/53fab88ff9d1b48f4704b5b5b560d6b4d560bf4c/icons/arrow-right.svg)
- [arrow-up-right.svg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/53fab88ff9d1b48f4704b5b5b560d6b4d560bf4c/icons/arrow-up-right.svg)
- [rotate-cw.svg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/53fab88ff9d1b48f4704b5b5b560d6b4d560bf4c/icons/rotate-cw.svg)
- [plus.svg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/53fab88ff9d1b48f4704b5b5b560d6b4d560bf4c/icons/plus.svg)
- [disc-3.svg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/53fab88ff9d1b48f4704b5b5b560d6b4d560bf4c/icons/disc-3.svg)
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/53fab88ff9d1b48f4704b5b5b560d6b4d560bf4c/LICENSE)

The original SVG files are included unchanged. `lucide.svg` packages their original attributes and geometry as SVG symbols for efficient reuse. The full upstream licence is included in `LICENSE-lucide.txt`.
